citations.quote: The ExteNET (Extended Adjuvant Treatment of Breast Cancer with Neratinib) study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of neratinib after trastuzumab in women with early-stage HER2/neu overexpressed/amplified breast cancer.

The safety and efficacy of NERLYNX were investigated in the ExteNET trial (NCT00878709), a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of NERLYNX after adjuvant treatment with trastuzumab in women with HER2-positive breast cancer.
The single trial supporting the efficacy review of this NDA is the Phase 3 randomized double-blind, placebo-controlled trial ExteNET, or study 3004.

result.text: Primary analysis: 67 (4.7%) iDFS events on neratinib vs 106 (7.5%) on placebo; stratified HR 0.66 (95% CI 0.49, 0.90); two-sided stratified log-rank p=0.008; iDFS at 24 months 94.2% vs 91.9%.

key_safety.text: Diarrhea was the most common adverse reaction, reported in 95% of NERLYNX-treated patients (Grade 3 in 40%, Grade 4 in 0.1%) vs 35% on placebo; other common reactions included nausea (43% vs 22%), abdominal pain (36% vs 15%) and vomiting (26% vs 8%). Diarrhea was also the most common AE leading to discontinuation (16.8%).

citations.quote: Diarrhea was reported in 95% of NERLYNX-treated patients in ExteNET, a randomized placebo controlled trial. In the NERLYNX arm, Grade 3 diarrhea occurred in 40% and Grade 4 diarrhea occurred in 0.1% of patients.

requirement.text: 3223-1: Conduct a PBPK modeling/simulation study (or clinical PK trial) to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor on the single-dose PK of neratinib and its active metabolites.

citations.quote: 3223-1 Conduct a physiologically-based pharmacokinetic modeling/simulation study to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor on the single dose pharmacokinetics of neratinib and its active metabolites to assess the magnitude of increased drug exposure and to address the potential for excessive drug toxicity.
